qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Conglomerate structure across cyclical electronic chemicals, life science tools, and mid-tier pharma lacks an overarching moat; 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 9.0% falls well short of the 12% hurdle due to heavy historical acquisition goodwill.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3a (Moat Archetype: None) and Gate 3b (Pricing & Proof of Moat, REJECT). 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 9.0% falls well below the 12% hurdle, burdened by €25B+ in acquisition goodwill, while cyclical electronics specialty chemicals lack pricing power.
qualitative.evidence: GAAP ROIC has steadily declined from 10.56% in FY2022 to 8.27% in FY2025 (median 9.03%), reflecting persistent balance sheet dilution from historical mega-acquisitions (Sigma-Aldrich, Versum). The electronics materials division is exposed to cyclical semiconductor demand fluctuations, and Life Science faced customer destocking, preventing the business from demonstrating sustained pricing power >= inflation.
